title: nf-core/phaseimpute pipeline - params.input_mixblup schema
description: Schema for the Mixblup input samplesheet file used by the phaseimpute pipeline

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must only contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens. Spaces are not allowed.

gtp.errorMessage: Mixblup genotype file (gtp.mix) must be provided and cannot contain spaces

ped.errorMessage: Mixblup pedigree file (ped.mix) must be provided and cannot contain spaces

map.errorMessage: Mixblup map file (map.mix) with SNP positions and alleles must be provided and cannot contain spaces

manifest.errorMessage: SNP details file (.txt) with Y/N marker filter must be provided and cannot contain spaces
